for.en: One trip, bought by you or your AI agent while it plans it. If a flight is delayed or cancelled, Cover sees it and pays you in minutes, with no claim to file
for.zh: 一趟旅程，你或你的 AI agent 規劃行程時順手投保。航班延誤或取消時，Cover 自己會知道，幾分鐘內直接付款給你，不用申請理賠

options.zh: 加拿大、墨西哥或加勒比海

questions.en: Your flights: number and date, one per line (e.g. UA857 2026-12-20)
questions.zh: 你的航班：每行一個航班號和日期（例如 UA857 2026-12-20）

questions.en: How much of the trip is prepaid and non-refundable, per traveler?
questions.zh: 每人已預付且不能退的旅費有多少？

options.en: Flight only: delay, cancellation, lost-bag delay
options.zh: 只保航班：延誤、取消、行李延誤

options.en: Standard: flight, plus $50,000 emergency medical and trip cancellation
options.zh: 標準：航班，加上 5 萬美元緊急醫療和旅程取消

options.en: Plus: flight, $250,000 medical and evacuation, trip cancellation
options.zh: 加強：航班，加上 25 萬美元醫療與後送、旅程取消

coverages.en: Flight delay: $100 a traveler at 2 hours, $300 at 6 hours, paid automatically
coverages.zh: 航班延誤：延誤 2 小時每人 100 美元，6 小時每人 300 美元，自動給付

coverages.en: Flight cancelled: $300 a traveler, paid automatically
coverages.zh: 航班取消：每人 300 美元，自動給付

coverages.en: Bag delayed 12 hours or more: $200 a traveler for essentials
coverages.zh: 行李延誤 12 小時以上：每人 200 美元購買必需品

coverages.en: Trip cancellation for a covered reason, up to the prepaid cost
coverages.zh: 因承保原因取消旅程，最高為已預付旅費

claims.en: My checked bag was delayed 12 hours or more
claims.zh: 託運行李延誤 12 小時以上

claims.en: I needed emergency medical care on the trip
I had to cancel the trip

clauses.en: "Insured flights" are the flights listed on the policy, by flight number and scheduled date. The "trip" runs from the scheduled departure of the first insured flight to the arrival of the last, and no longer than 90 days.
clauses.zh: 「承保航班」指保單所列之航班（航班號與表定日期）。「旅程」自第一個承保航班表定起飛起，至最後一個航班抵達止，最長 90 日。

clauses.en: "Delay" is the time between an insured flight's scheduled departure and its actual departure (wheels off the gate), as reported by Cover's flight-status source. Cover's record of that report, signed into its transparency log, is the evidence; you file nothing.
clauses.zh: 「延誤」指承保航班表定起飛時間與實際起飛（離開登機門）時間之差，以 Cover 的航班狀態來源為準。Cover 對該資料的紀錄會簽章並記入透明帳本作為證據，你不需要申請任何東西。

clauses.en: When an insured flight departs 2 hours or more late, we pay $100 for each traveler on the policy; at 6 hours or more, $300 instead. It is paid automatically to your PayPal once the flight departs, at most $600 per traveler per trip.
clauses.zh: 承保航班延誤 2 小時以上起飛時，保單上每位旅客給付 100 美元；延誤 6 小時以上改為每位 300 美元。航班起飛後自動付到你的 PayPal，每位旅客每趟旅程最高 600 美元。

clauses.en: When an insured flight is cancelled by the airline, we pay $300 for each traveler on the policy, automatically, at most $600 per traveler per trip together with TR-2.1. A flight cancelled and then delayed on rebooking counts once, as the higher amount.
clauses.zh: 承保航班遭航空公司取消時，保單上每位旅客自動給付 300 美元，與 TR-2.1 合計每位旅客每趟最高 600 美元。航班取消後改搭又延誤者，只算一次，取較高金額。

clauses.en: When a checked bag is delayed 12 hours or more on the outbound journey, we pay $200 for each traveler whose bag was delayed, for essentials. Give us the airline's property irregularity report (PIR) number.
clauses.zh: 去程託運行李延誤 12 小時以上時，行李延誤的每位旅客給付 200 美元購買必需品。請提供航空公司的行李異常報告（PIR）編號。

clauses.en: Standard and Plus: emergency medical care for a sudden illness or injury during the trip and outside your home country, up to $50,000 (Standard) or $250,000 with emergency evacuation (Plus) per traveler, less a $100 deductible. A person decides every medical claim.
clauses.zh: 標準與加強方案：旅程中於居住國以外突發疾病或受傷之緊急醫療，每位旅客最高 5 萬美元（標準）或 25 萬美元含緊急後送（加強），扣除 100 美元自負額。所有醫療理賠由真人審核。

clauses.en: Standard and Plus: if you must cancel before departure because you, a traveling companion or an immediate family member becomes seriously ill, is injured or dies, or because of a hurricane or other weather making your destination unlivable, we refund the prepaid, non-refundable trip cost. A person decides every cancellation claim.
clauses.zh: 標準與加強方案：出發前因你、同行旅伴或直系親屬重病、受傷或身故，或颶風等天候使目的地無法居住而必須取消時，我們退還已預付且不可退的旅費。所有取消理賠由真人審核。

clauses.en: No payment for a delay or cancellation already announced, or a storm already named, when the policy was bought. Cover checks each flight's status at purchase and won't insure a flight that is already disrupted.
clauses.zh: 購買保單時已公布的延誤或取消，或已命名的風暴，不予理賠。Cover 購買時會檢查每個航班的狀態，已受影響的航班不予承保。

clauses.en: No payment if you didn't hold a confirmed seat on the flight, for flights you change after buying unless you update the policy, for strikes announced before purchase, or for war, government travel bans or pre-existing conditions (medical).
clauses.zh: 未持有該航班確認機位、購買後自行更改航班而未更新保單、購買前已宣布的罷工，以及戰爭、政府旅遊禁令或既往症（醫療），不予理賠。

clauses.en: Flight payments need nothing from you. Other claims: tell us what happened within 90 days, with the PIR, medical records or receipts the claim type lists.
clauses.zh: 航班給付不需要你提供任何東西。其他理賠：請在 90 日內告訴我們發生了什麼，並附上該理賠類型所需的 PIR、病歷或收據。

clauses.en: False information lets us deny the claim and cancel the policy. One policy per trip per traveler; a second policy on the same flights pays nothing more.
clauses.zh: 提供不實資料者，我們得拒絕理賠並終止保單。每位旅客每趟旅程限一張保單；同一航班重複投保不另行給付。

clauses.en: One premium for the trip. Cancel before the first insured flight departs for a full refund. 20% of the premium is Cover's flat fee; the rest goes to the claims pool, and what is left after the year goes to the cause you chose.
clauses.zh: 每趟旅程一次繳清。第一個承保航班起飛前退保，全額退費。保費的 20% 為 Cover 的固定費用，其餘進入理賠池；年度結算後剩餘捐給你選的公益團體。
